title: Operation Whiskerfall original raster atlas
copyright: Original generated artwork produced for this project; no third-party game assets used.
coordinateConvention: Source rectangles use integer pixels with nearest-edge rounding. pivots are normalized within each source frame. All row and column numbers are zero based.

bodies.notes: Live player body frames use measured bounds around each main alpha component. These exact crops exclude neighboring sprites and discarded faint generation residue. Bodies are fitted to68px idle height without changing proportions. Full heads, torsos and legs; arms are rendered separately.

arms.notes: Each frame is one complete arms-and-weapon assembly. Rotate about the shoulder pivot. For left aim, mirror horizontally and subtract/add pi from rotation so gun top remains upright. Run-body time is independent of firing time. Recoil and blade swing animate the arms layer.

attachment.description: Attach to player chest; preserve upright local rotation and mirror for left aim.

terrain.notes: Opaque edge-to-edge ground textures; rivers and roads use independent smooth path overlays.
